images.description: Steam in a game-console experience through nested Gamescope (legacy Big Picture, the games-on-whales-validated game-foreground path). Needs a host --shm-size bump, 32-bit graphics libraries, and PUID/PGID matching the managed home.
images.notes: direct_display: the image can run as a console session, gamescope on its own DRM backend, when the agent sets QUASAR_DIRECT_DISPLAY=1 (quasar#453); no_new_privileges MUST be false: Steam's startup re-escalates via sudo inside the container, which the default --security-opt no-new-privileges blocks (black bare compositor otherwise). This knob rides apps.runtime_spec, not the runtime_presets columns — see MANIFEST.md 'runtime mapping'. network MUST be "bridge": Steam's first boot downloads steamui.so and clean-exits fatal under the hardened --network none default (first-run-experience spec §S2, #463) — this maps onto the runtime_presets.network column, hardened default stays "none" for every other image. runtime.env STEAM_STARTUP_FLAGS=-bigpicture is the plain Steam app's UI mode: the image bakes in no UI-mode default, so this preset value is what keeps Big Picture; a derived game tile overrides it wholesale with its own flags.

images.description: KDE Plasma 6 Wayland desktop session with the Steam desktop client, user-level Flatpak (Discover), and Quasar branding. Runs nested under the Quasar compositor; the whole mutable state lives in the /home/quasar volume (org.quasar.image.persist). Needs a host --shm-size bump and PUID/PGID matching the managed home, like Steam.
images.notes: direct_display: the image can run as a console session, on KWin's DRM backend, when the agent sets QUASAR_DIRECT_DISPLAY=1 (quasar#453); no_new_privileges MUST be false: the bundled Steam desktop client's startup re-escalates via sudo, same as the steam image. network MUST be "bridge" (Steam sign-in/downloads). systempaths_unconfined MUST be true: user Flatpak's bwrap mounts a fresh /proc inside its own mount namespace, and Docker's masked paths block that mount even with seccomp=unconfined already in place — flatpak install works but flatpak run fails mounting /proc without it (live-verified 2026-08-13). Desktop-session host requirements beyond the preset (agent-side, not yet preset-mappable): unprivileged user namespaces (seccomp permitting CLONE_NEWUSER — the agent's seccomp=unconfined covers it). One running session per home volume (org.quasar.image.session=desktop).

images.description: XFCE 4 X11 desktop session with the Steam desktop client, user-level Flatpak (gnome-software), Firefox, and Quasar branding. Runs a rootful Xwayland nested under the Quasar compositor (there is no Wayland XFCE session); the whole mutable state lives in the /home/quasar volume (org.quasar.image.persist). Needs a host --shm-size bump and PUID/PGID matching the managed home, like Steam.
images.notes: no_new_privileges MUST be false: the bundled Steam desktop client's startup re-escalates via sudo, same as the steam and kde-desktop images. network MUST be "bridge" (Steam sign-in/downloads). systempaths_unconfined MUST be true: user Flatpak's bwrap mounts a fresh /proc inside its own mount namespace, and Docker's masked paths block that mount even with seccomp=unconfined already in place — flatpak install works but flatpak run fails mounting /proc without it (live-verified 2026-08-13 on kde-desktop; the same Flatpak stack ships here). Desktop-session host requirements beyond the preset (agent-side, not yet preset-mappable): unprivileged user namespaces (seccomp permitting CLONE_NEWUSER — the agent's seccomp=unconfined covers it). One running session per home volume (org.quasar.image.session=desktop). Resolution is deliberately absent from env: the launcher takes the session mode from QUASAR_STREAM_WIDTH/HEIGHT (quasar#384) and sizes the rootful Xwayland with -geometry, so a pinned value here would shadow it for every session.

images.description: UNIGINE Heaven 4.0 and Superposition 1.1 as a self-driving, looping GPU benchmark workload for Quasar streaming tests. Takes no input: the PHORONIX automation define runs the full scene sequence unattended, prints a score, exits, and the launcher restarts it. Bridges Quasar's Wayland session to the benchmarks' X11/GLX with stock gamescope.
images.notes: kind=template on purpose (a host builds it with the classic builder, so the Dockerfile uses no `RUN --mount`, and build_args.APP_IMAGE pins the published quasar-app it builds FROM, since the Dockerfile's own default `quasar-app:dev` exists on no host; the pinned digest was quasar-app :latest and :develop on 2026-10-22; quasar#615): the UNIGINE installers are ~1.9 GB of third-party downloads with their own EULAs, so this image is deliberately NOT published to ghcr and has no registry_ref to pin. Unlike steam/kde this image needs no security relaxations — no_new_privileges stays true and network stays none (the benchmarks are fully self-contained; the only network traffic is at BUILD time). Resolution is deliberately absent from env: the launcher takes the session mode from QUASAR_STREAM_WIDTH/HEIGHT (quasar#384), and a pinned UNIGINE_WIDTH/HEIGHT here would shadow it for every session. Results land in the managed home under ~/unigine-bench/run-<ts>/ and are also teed to stdout with a [unigine-result] prefix.
